'''Garn Delroix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual who operated the [[Delroix Speeders]] shop in the town of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was a squat person who, by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], was in his fifties.
